neighbours.label: the slot just before a participial (-ing) clause of change: the comma or adverb that leads into 'increasing', 'changing', 'turning' (its output promotes those verbs)
fire: The factory added a night shift, sharply boosting its output.
Interest rates fell again, quickly reviving the housing market.
Over the years the town grew, gradually swallowing the nearby farms.
The new policy could hurt exporters, possibly raising prices for shoppers.
Engineers redesigned the engine, dramatically cutting its fuel use.
Heavy rains soaked the region, eventually turning the fields into lakes.
The club signed two strikers, significantly strengthening its attack.
Wind slowly reshaped the dunes, constantly shifting their outline.
quiet: The factory added a night shift, and its output went up.
Interest rates fell again. The housing market recovered soon after.
Over the years the town grew until it reached the nearby farms.
The new policy could hurt exporters. Shoppers may pay more.
Engineers redesigned the engine so that it uses less fuel.
Heavy rains soaked the region and the fields became lakes.
The club signed two strikers, so its attack is stronger now.
Wind reshaped the dunes, and their outline is never the same.

notes: Card flags broad (1.3% of tokens reach 0.1 of max); near misses may fire weakly on commas.
